title: Understanding Probability Assignments
text: Think about what it means to assign a probability like $$\$P(Y=1|X)=0.3\$$$. How does this affect the likelihood of an event occurring?

title: Comparing Probabilities
text: Consider how the probabilities $$\$P(Y=1|X)=0.3\$$$ and $$\$P(Y=1|X)=0.4\$$$ differ. What does a higher probability imply about the event?

title: Probability Impact on ROC
text: If the probability of $$\$Y=1\$$$ increases from $$0.3$$ to $$0.4$$, how might this affect the true positive rate in an ROC curve?
choices: It decreases the true positive rate
It has no effect on the true positive rate
It increases the true positive rate

title: Understanding ROC Curves
text: An ROC curve plots the true positive rate against the false positive rate. How might changes in probability assignments affect these rates?

title: Effect of Probability on ROC
text: Given the probabilities $$\$P(Y=1|X)=0.3\$$$ and $$\$P(Y=1|X)=0.4\$$$, which ROC curve might represent a better classifier?
